spans.s:
मुग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
 1. Lovely, beautiful.
 2. Stupid, ignorant, an
idiot, a fool.
 3. Simple, silly.
 4. Infatuated.
 f. (-ग्धा) A young and
lovely female.
 E. मुह् to be foolish, aff. क्त, deriv. irr.
मुग्धा f. (-ग्धा) A girl attractive by her artlessness, (in rhetoric.)

. Ignorance, stupidity.
 3. Simplicity. E.
मुग्ध and तल् added; also मुग्धत्वं ।

मुग्धानन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Lovely-faced.
 E. मुग्ध and आनन face.
